adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the email-sending block explicitly swallows failures: `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(...) } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }`. The caught `err` is unused, so logs omit the underlying error details and the handler still returns success after mutating DB/calendar state, making email-delivery failures hard to diagnose (a silent/partial failure in notification side-effects). This is a concrete, diff-grounded review issue, but not necessarily a functional defect in the booking update itself.
